messages:
marta: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — noticed a recurring pattern where our edge LB re-resolves DNS aggressively when upstream TLS handshakes time out, which trips the rotation thresholds and causes short-lived routing flaps. We need owners + timelines for the action items.
sam: I saw the same in the traces. At 03:12 UTC there was a retry storm: lots of 504s then multiple DNS lookups in <2s. Probable root cause: resolver retries + immediate LB rotation.
ken: Can you paste the problematic log snippet? I want to see the TTL and resolver error.
marta: sure — snippet from edge logs:
```
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z lb.edge: upstream_tls_handshake_timeout host=x.y.z, attempt=1
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z dns.resolver: lookup=host.example.internal returned SERVFAIL; retry=1
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z lb.edge: rotation_threshold_exceeded last_resolve=1s
```
olivia: Oof. Two immediate things: (1) put a short circuit to avoid rotation on transient resolver errors, (2) increase DNS cache TTL on the edge to avoid tight re-resolves. Both low-risk.
jordan: Also saw TLS SNI mismatch annotated in the tls cache logs around the same time — cert reload + rapid rotate -> mismatch on fallback. That makes the client see TLS errors and retry => retry amplification.
sam: Proposed concrete items:
- A1: Add jitter + exponential backoff before triggering rotation on resolver failures (owner: ken). Target: patch in 3 business days, deploy to canary.
- A2: Increase edge DNS cache TTL to 30s and add a configurable minimum TTL (owner: olivia). Target: config change tomorrow, staged rollout in 2 days.
- A3: Circuit-breaker for repeated upstream TLS handshakes per host (owner: sam). If >5 handshake failures in 60s, stop routing to that host for 60s and mark as degraded. Target: PR in 1 week.
- A4: Add metrics and alert: rapid DNS re-resolve rate + rotation count spike (owner: marta). Target: dashboard + alert in 2 days.
ken: I can take A1. Implementation note: we should avoid changing kernel resolver; add a resolver wrapper in the LB process that does 3 retries with backoff before returning SERVFAIL upstream. I'll PR with tests.
olivia: I'll update infra config for A2 and coordinate with platform to ensure we don't break low-latency customers. Will document the change in the runbook.
sam: For A3 I'll draft the circuit-breaker logic. Need a quick design review — @ken can you eyeball the state machine? Small statefulness inside the LB process.
ken: Yep, will review. Keep state per upstream host, TTL-backed counters.
marta: infra-bot: create ticket for the follow-ups and link to postmortem
infra-bot: Created INC-4592: https://tracker.internal/INC-4592 - "edge: DNS rotation thresholds + TLS retry storm follow-ups" assigned to triage
jordan: small follow-up: add an end-to-end test that simulates resolver flapping and ensures we don't rotate in <5s. Owner: jordan. ETA: 1 week for test harness.
marta: ok owners assigned. I'll consolidate into the postmortem action table and ping on Wednesday for a status sync. Please update INC-4592 with PR links and deploy times. :thumbsup:
ken: starting A1 branch now, will ping in #eng-runtime when PR is up.
olivia: A2 done in staging — will promote after a short soak. Posting config diff in INC-4592.
sam: A3 design in a doc, sharing in thread.
jordan: adding e2e test outline to the ticket.
marta: Thanks everyone. We'll rerun the selector tests after A1/A2 and confirm no regression. If anything slips, escalate to eng-oncall.
